title: The reusable project CI runs every job on the runner its caller names
body:
Operator 2026-11-19: no paid Actions minutes; private krn-works repos run CI on a self-hosted runner on krn-dev (labels self-hosted, linux, x64, krn-ci-isolated). The reusable .github/workflows/project-ci.yml takes `runner` only for lint/build/test; the `plan` and final `check` jobs are fixed on ubuntu-24.04, so a private caller still needs billed hosted minutes and its required `Check` never starts once the included minutes are spent.
Principle: a reusable workflow runs every job on the runner its caller names.
Files: .github/workflows/project-ci.yml (+ its rule/contract test under test/ if one pins its shape)
Outcome: every job in project-ci.yml uses the `runner` input; the input accepts either a single label (default `ubuntu-24.04`, unchanged for existing callers) or a JSON array of labels (`["self-hosted","linux","x64","krn-ci-isolated"]`), e.g. `runs-on: ${{ startsWith(inputs.runner, '[') && fromJSON(inputs.runner) || inputs.runner }}`; the input description says so.
Proof: a test that parses project-ci.yml shows no job with a fixed runs-on, and actionlint/yaml checks in the repo pass.
